The season was named as "100 Años de [[Racing Club de Montevideo]]" and was originally scheduled to begin on 9 February but its start was pushed back for one week to 16 February.{{cite web |url=https://www.futbol.com.uy/Deportes/2019-Final-de-la-Supercopa-sera-el-3-de-febrero-y-el-Uruguayo-comenzara-el-9-y-10-uc704089|title=2019: Final de la Supercopa será el 3 de febrero y el Uruguayo comenzará el 9 y 10|publisher=FútbolUy|language=es|date=6 December 2018|access-date=28 December 2018}}{{cite web |url=https://www.elobservador.com.uy/nota/el-campeonato-uruguayo-comenzara-el-16-de-febrero-20192821136|title=El Campeonato Uruguayo comenzará el 16 de febrero|publisher=El Observador|language=es|date=8 February 2019}} The season ended on 15 December with [[Club Nacional de Football|Nacional]] winning their forty-seventh title by beating [[Peñarol]] in the semifinal.
